fusions.name: Full Draw
fusions.desc: Looses a fully drawn arrow that deals 34 damage, rising to twice that at its full reach of 9 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Nocked Trio
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Long Sighting
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Steady Aim
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
